html:
*Apologies folks - the previous link didn’t work!

Today I made an app called Make a Haiku.

Haikus are beautiful, short, and powerful. Originally from Japan, these mini poems follow a 5-7-5 syllable pattern.

It uses AI to generate a haiku based on your prompt.

Try it out and let me know what you think.
